guard_mechanism.date_header: Compare exact normalized visible entry text, computed from approved declared date and edition; require the sole time datetime attribute to equal approved publication_date.
guard_mechanism.citation: Compare first visible citation paragraph exactly with approved author/year/title/citation edition/DOI; require exactly two paragraphs and exact BibTeX label.
guard_mechanism.status: Compare the complete ordered status paragraph list with all approved status/AI disclosure and optional edition-note strings.
guard_mechanism.optimization: Three test() boolean comparisons append issues directly; they are not Python assert statements and remain active under -O.
guard_mechanism.variable_effect: The inserted visible_text callable is confined in use to this block. The older loop assigns the ordinary visible_text string before every older record check; other added names are not consumed by older branches.
guard_mechanism.scope_limit: Checks harden these approved exact HTML structures; no universal HTML/CSS visibility or adversarial parser security certification.
